method: Lexicographically first anonymous roster IDs per prespecified source/stratum; independent of results.
purpose: Implementation and sensitivity audit only; excluded from tuning, adoption gates and outcome prediction.
notes: Each participant set counts once; engine evaluations and pair swaps are separate denominators.
Observed matches are replayed at the frozen current snapshot; these are not historical predictions.
The 0.1 perturbation is injected after player scoring in disposable modules; source ratings, personal MMR, admin overrides and roles are unchanged.
Perturbed selections are reevaluated with unperturbed frozen scores to disclose discontinuities; this audit does not tune the algorithm.
Swap changes reflect actual player strength and assigned-role penalties, not estimated win probabilities.
Timings are sequential within this process, without warmup; other simultaneous processes may contend for CPU.

sampleDiagnostics.countingUnit: Participant-role assignment appearances across these 14 rosters, not unique players.
sampleDiagnostics.reconstruction: Original null-only counts read from results, or exactly recovered only after asserting all five role sample fields share nullability for each participant. No team search is rerun.
